settings.heading: Build your own hamper
settings.body:
Choose the occasion, a budget, and the chocolates you want inside. We pack bars, dragée, bonbons, and a note card, then confirm the edit before you pay.

Useful for birthdays, hosts, and a small run of matching gifts.

settings.text: Occasion, budget, and number of hampers

settings.heading: We assemble it. You approve it.
settings.text: Share the date you need them, the city they are going to, and whether every hamper should match.

settings.heading: Send the brief
settings.text: Tell us the occasion, quantity, budget, and anything that should be written on the card.
